title: WebEvidenceReceipt v1
description: A provenance receipt for one browser-agent research task. Every quote is verbatim page text captured by the agent; the receipt records where it came from, when, what it cost, and whether the run was fully cited. Receipts are intake records, not claims: they enter the ledger as `observed` evidence and never upgrade a claim status on their own.

receipt_id.description: Stable identifier derived from the receipt hash.

receipt_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of this receipt with `receipt_id` and `receipt_sha256` removed.

llm_models.description: Model identifiers the run used for planning and reading, when known.

run_status.description: The agent's own exit status, copied verbatim.

citable.description: True only when run_status is `complete` (every claim backed by a quote) and at least one quote exists.

answer.description: The agent's free-text answer. Never cite this; cite `quotes`.

data.description: Structured output matching the caller's schema, when one was supplied.

cost_dollars.description: Sum of known dollar cost lines. Unknown-cost lines are counted in `cost_lines_unknown`.

path.description: Repo-relative path to the raw `fastbrowse --json` output this receipt was built from.

quote.description: Verbatim page text as captured by the agent.

quote_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 quote text, computed at receipt time.

capture_sha256.description: The agent's hash of the page capture the quote was cut from.
